# What does this PR do?

Describe the change and why it is needed. The PR title becomes the commit on
main and the line in the release notes, so it must follow Conventional

-->

Fixes # (issue)

<!--
PRs need an issue approved by the maintainer first. PRs without one may be
closed. Typo and docs fixes can skip this.
-->

## Before submitting

- [ ] This PR only fixes a typo or improves the docs (you can skip the other checks).
- [ ] I read the [contributing guide](https://github.com/aquarelahq/aquarela/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).
- [ ] The change was approved in an issue, linked above.
- [ ] I updated `docs/api.md` or `docs/data-model.md` if the API or the data changed.
- [ ] I added a line under `[Unreleased]` in `CHANGELOG.md`.
- [ ] I ticked `ROADMAP.md` if this finishes an item.
- [ ] I added or updated tests where needed.
- [ ] The PR changes fewer than 400 lines, or it does one thing that cannot be split.

## AI usage

AI tools are welcome, and you are responsible for every line. Tick one.

- [ ] No AI usage.
- [ ] AI-assisted. AI suggested or improved parts, and I wrote and reviewed the PR.
- [ ] AI-generated. AI wrote most or all of it, and I reviewed, understood and tested every line.
